scope: Bounded classical/general theorem family audit. Primary claims only. No absence-based novelty certificate.

entries.title: Reznik–Garcia–Koiller, Eighty New Invariants
entries.passages_read: Introduction; §2 signed areas; §§3.4,3.7; Table7 p9; ref/classical auxiliary circle scope
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Defines exact target k605,a as outer tangent focal-pedal product for odd N; classical focal-foot circle k301 is separate.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: The question mark reflects this edition, not historical absence of later proofs.

entries.title: Reznik–Garcia–Koiller, Fifty New Invariants
entries.passages_read: §2 signed-area convention; §3.7; Table7 printed349
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Exact primed target renamed k606; k605 is unprimed chord-pedal area product.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: No edition-label transfer.

entries.title: Akopyan–Schwartz–Tabachnikov, Billiards in ellipses revisited
entries.passages_read: Introduction main theorems; §2; Cor6.4; complete §7 area-ratio proof pp10–11
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Odd original/tangent area ratio for concentric ellipses; classical complex-pole and grid mechanisms.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Our auxiliary circle and focal caustic are not concentric; no direct theorem about paired pedal products.

entries.title: Akopyan–Schwartz–Tabachnikov, published final
entries.passages_read: Theorem1.3 printed1315; complete §7 printed1325–1326 and added grid explanation
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Affine grid correspondence justifies stated area ratio.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Live web PDF returned internal error; already fetched primary payload reused read-only. Not an area theorem for arbitrary projectivities.

entries.title: Chavez-Caliz, More About Areas and Centers of Poncelet Polygons
entries.passages_read: §2 algebraic areas/degeneracy; Theorems2–3; full §5 Theorem6 proof printed104
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Even original/tangent area product for concentric ellipses; complementary zero/pole mechanism is old.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Wrong parity and objects for direct target implication; projective transport requires additional area weights.

entries.title: Bialy–Tabachnikov, Dan Reznik identities and more
entries.passages_read: §§2–4: generating function, Thm2.2, Cor3.2, Thm3.3, full Thm4.1 proof, Lemma4.2/Thm4.3
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Stationary outer-pedal vertex centroid/squared-distance sum; focal side-distance product, with stated parity.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: None identifies the two focal shoelace sums or their product. Sums of individual foot functions do not determine adjacent cross products.

entries.title: Khare–Lakshminarayan–Sukhatme, Cyclic Identities II
entries.passages_read: §2 pp4–9 master derivations; §4(i) pp14–15 dn half-period identity and Eq66; auxiliary function reductions
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Finite Fourier filtering and elliptic principal-part reconstruction are old; dn real-half-period product explicitly recalled.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: No focal-foot or ordered contact-polygon reduction is printed in read passages. Mixed-class area summands cannot be assumed to fit one master class without checking.

entries.title: Khare–Lakshminarayan–Sukhatme, Local Identities
entries.passages_read: §4 pp11–14, Eq39 symmetry classes, Eq40–45 principal-part master identities and proofs; §2 addition forms
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: At most one simple pole in reduced half-cell with dn character gives a scaled dn by the old type-I reconstruction.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: This credits analytic organization; it does not itself verify focal geometry, collapsed pole cancellation or source-specific priority.

entries.title: Stachel, On the motion of billiards in ellipses
entries.passages_read: Theorem4.3/Eq4.9 printed1614; Thm4.6 printed1616; §5 Lemma5.3 and Thms5.4–5.6 printed1620–1621
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Exact canonical parametrization, primitive coprime turning numbers and semiaxis-step identities.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Read §5 conclusions concern even tangent-length products, not odd focal-pedal area product. Live DOI transport failed; primary existing payload used.

entries.title: Stachel, Geometry of billiards in ellipses and Poncelet grids
entries.passages_read: Independently read actual primary text of Theorems3.5–3.6 and adjoining §3 grid mechanism, PDFpp9–12; existing primary file used read-only after map freeze
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Grid/diagonal conics and affine correspondences provide geometric tools.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: No focal metric-area implication verified. No exhaustive audit of the entire long paper is claimed.

entries.title: Stachel, On the Diagonals of Billiards
entries.passages_read: Theorems1–3, full §4 Theorem5/Cor6 on PDFpp8–9; abstract/conclusions
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: General circumconic/inconic characterization via polarity to adjacent first diagonals.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Incidence/polarity does not preserve Euclidean areas or identify the original focus feet; no product theorem in read conclusions.

entries.title: Stachel, A Triple of Projective Billiards
entries.passages_read: Official abstract, publisher metadata and indexed §2 excerpt only
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Projects inner/outer billiards and Poncelet grids.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Official full PDF attempts returned418; no full theorem/proof reading or exclusion claim. Bibliographic leads alone are not priority evidence.

entries.title: Roitman–Garcia–Reznik, New Invariants of Poncelet–Jacobi Bicentric Polygons
entries.passages_read: §2 Jacobi parametrization pp3–4; Thms1–2; Cor1; §5; AppendixA Lemmas2–3; B/C circle–confocal polarity; Table1 conjectural area videos
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Focal polar of ellipse is circle; bicentric limiting-point pedals match focus inversions; actual proved observable is perimeter.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Target is contact-polygon area at incircle center, not limiting-point pedal perimeter. Printed σ=4τK/N is not borrowed: fresh bridge derives physical σ=2K_bτ/N from Stachel and Gauss, avoiding even-period ambiguity.

entries.title: Radic, Certain relations obtained starting with three positive real numbers
entries.passages_read: Definitions/closure conventions pp49–55; Cor2.2/conjugate tangent lengths; Conjecture2 Eq2.19/2.20 pp65–66; following conditional area statement
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Prior conjugate bicentric area/perimeter product lead, low-order formulas for2n=6,8.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: General product is explicitly conjectural and rotation-number-one terminology is used; neither an all-odd theorem nor the contact/focus bridge can be presumed.

entries.title: Garcia–Reznik–Roitman, New Properties of Harmonic Polygons
entries.passages_read: §1 definitions; §2 construction; §3 Thm1; §4 Props4–7, Prop6/Conj1 lateral area reciprocal sums pp10–12
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Harmonic pair is polar of homothetic ellipse pair; area reciprocal sum proved onlyN3,5 in read result.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Our pair is transverse, whereas homothetic/associated harmonic pair has double-contact degeneracy. Their reciprocal sum is not this product; no identity of families follows from having circular outer conic.

entries.title: Reznik–Garcia–Stachel, Area-Invariant Pedal-Like Curves Derived from the Ellipse
entries.passages_read: §2 Sturm/Steiner circular isocurves; §3 Prop2 p8; §4 main statements; AppendixB Prop7
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Classical Steiner mechanism and continuous pedal-area formula; focus ellipse pedal curve has full areaπa².
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Fixed-polygon moving-pedal-point/continuous-curve results do not imply finite moving ordered polygon product. Single focal polygon areas vary in fresh exact-source numerical controls.

entries.title: Garcia–Gheorghe, Poncelet Pairs via Isogonal Conjugacy
entries.passages_read: Introduction/main result scope; §3 Thm3.1 and Remark3.2; main statements §§4–6
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: For triangles, circle center at inellipse focus implies other focus is common orthocenter: MacBeath identification.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Entire stated setting is3-Poncelet; no all-odd paired focal-pedal area theorem appears in read statements.

entries.title: Hungerbuhler–Wasem, Poncelet curves
entries.passages_read: Abstract; §§1–3 principal theorem statements and construction formulas; equiangular and congruent family hypotheses
entries.verified_bridge_or_credit: Universal constructions of sufficiently regular Poncelet curve pairs/clans.
entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Closure/construction theorem is not a statement that a metric derived-area observable is constant; no target implication verified.

entries.remaining_gap_or_scope_exclusion: Analytic identity printed; source-specific focal-foot/contact-area reductions freshly derived in this audit.
